explication: thepopebot combines authenticated web and Telegram chat, configurable LLM/coding agents, persistent coding workspaces, and background agent jobs. The central workflow is a user message routed through the event handler to the AI runtime, which streams a response and can work in a repository; a separate job path runs work in Docker and returns results through GitHub/Telegram. The graph also shows code, cluster, and configuration capabilities. Some connections are documented in the README; unsampled implementations are represented conservatively.
